subject: Running late
body: Hi, my train got cancelled and I'll only reach the office around 2:30 but the interview starts at 2. Can someone let the panel know?

subject: Can't do this morning
body: I just woke up with a fever and can't do the video call at 10 this morning. Please advise as soon as you can.

subject: Joining by phone
body: Heads up, my internet is down right now so I'll be joining the call in 5 minutes from my phone. Hope that's okay.

subject: Offer letter
body: Thanks so much for the offer letter! Before I sign, could you send the final contract with the salary breakdown spelled out? I'd also like to talk about the bonus.

subject: Re: Offer
body: I got your offer. The base is lower than I expected. Is there any room to negotiate?

subject: Start date
body: Great news on the offer! Could I push my start date to the first of next month?

subject: No replies
body: Nobody has replied to my last two emails. I'm starting to think this company doesn't care about candidates at all.

subject: Assessment crashed
body: The assessment platform crashed halfway and I lost all my answers, and the support email bounced. This has been a terrible experience.

subject: After my interview
body: I still haven't heard anything after my interview two weeks ago. Can you tell me where things are?

subject: Withdrawal
body: I've decided to take another role, so please withdraw my application. Thanks for the opportunity.

subject: Benefits
body: Could you tell me what the benefits package looks like for this position?

subject: CV upload
body: My CV upload keeps timing out on the careers page. Is there an email address I can send it to instead?

subject: Second interview
body: I'm available next Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon for the second interview. What suits the team?

subject: Thank you
body: Thanks again for your time yesterday, I really enjoyed meeting everyone.
